title: Multi-agent team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/multi-agent.yaml: the team layer of the multi-agent plugin's role map. A value here overrides the bundled default and the user file the role_map_file option names, and a personal docs/conventions/multi-agent.local.yaml overrides it. Keys and resolution: plugins/multi-agent/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

schema.description: The layer format version. The resolver skips a layer that declares any other value.

workloads.description: Workload declarations: true declares workload <w>, false withdraws it.

roles.description: Per-role model and effort. A role is orchestrator, worker, verifier or retrieval.

frontier.description: Comma-separated model aliases treated as frontier.

frontier_guard.description: When true, a fan-out stage that would run on a frontier model runs on fanout.model.

model.description: The model alias a guarded fan-out stage uses.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from this team file's committed copy on the default branch only, so a branch cannot lower it and the user and personal files cannot set it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example audit-defaults); an entry beats this file's verification value.

vendors.description: Vendor routing switches, trial counts, per-vendor availability and ranking, and per-source enable overrides.

routing.description: When false, /multi-agent:route vendors reports routing is off and recommends nothing.

trials.description: When true with trials_prove and trials_fail set, unproven vendor pairs run through trials.

auto_delegation.description: When true, eligible routed work delegates automatically; false recommends without delegating.

trials_prove.description: Accepted trial results required to mark a pair proven. Unset by default.

trials_fail.description: Rejected trial results required to mark a pair failed. Minimum 2; unset by default.

sources.description: Per-registry-row enable overrides, keyed by benchmark registry row id.

workloads.description: Per-workload overrides, keyed by a declared workload name.
